contractText:
SERVICE AGREEMENT between Helvetic Print Services AG, Bern ("Supplier") and ACME Insurance Ltd, Zurich ("Customer").

1. Services. Printing and mailing of policy documents. Annual fee CHF 85,000.
2. Payment. Net 30 days.
3. Term. 24 months, ending automatically. Either party may terminate with 60 days' notice.
4. Liability. Each party's liability is capped at CHF 85,000 per contract year, except for gross negligence and intent.
5. Data Protection. Supplier processes policyholder addresses exclusively in Switzerland under the attached DPA.
6. Governing Law. Swiss law, venue Zurich.
